english.title: Fail to produce a driving instruction certificate / licence - Road Traffic Act 1988
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom a

(A)_[certificate]_
(B)_[licence]_

under Part V of the Road Traffic Act 1988 had been granted, failed when required by a

(C)_[constable]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), a person authorised in writing by the Secretary of State,]_

to produce it for examination
english.legislation: Contrary to section 137 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
